# Dennan

> Dennan Baby To Kids is Uganda's number one distributor in the baby and kids market. Founded in 2013, Dennan runs 2 physical branches in Kampala plus an online store at dennan.ug, stocking curated baby, kid, and mum care essentials imported from the UK, Turkey, Dubai, China, Vietnam, and the USA.

Dennan sells everyday must-haves and gifts across three parenting stages (Expectant & New Mom, Newborn, Baby & Toddler) and three tiers (Essentials, Must-Haves, Luxuries). Prices are listed in Ugandan Shillings (UGX). Orders can be placed online for delivery, or picked up at either Kampala branch.

## Shop
- [All products](https://dennan.ug/category/all): Full catalog across every stage and category.
- [Expectant & New Mom](https://dennan.ug/category/mother): Pregnancy comfort, nursing, and postpartum recovery essentials.
- [Newborn 0-6 months](https://dennan.ug/category/newborn): Newborn sleep, clothing, bathing, and feeding essentials.
- [Baby & Toddler](https://dennan.ug/category/kid): Play & learn, weaning, mobility, and safety gear.
- [Essentials](https://dennan.ug/collection/essentials): Absolute basics tier.
- [Must-Haves](https://dennan.ug/collection/must-haves): Highly recommended gear tier.
- [Luxuries](https://dennan.ug/collection/luxuries): Premium tier.
- [Most Loved](https://dennan.ug/collection/most-loved): Top-rated products by customer reviews.
- [Curated Picks](https://dennan.ug/collection/curated-picks): Hand-selected picks backed by pediatric guidelines.

## Product categories
Expectant and New Mom Essentials, Newborn Essentials & Kids Apparel/Footwear, Nursery and Furnishing, Feeding/Nursing Essentials, Bathing and Changing, Baby Play and Safety Gear, Travel Must-Haves.

## Company
- [About Dennan](https://dennan.ug/about): Company history, founding, and heritage.
- [Registry](https://dennan.ug/registry): Baby registry / gift list creation for expecting parents.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers
- Individual product pages live at `https://dennan.ug/product/{productId}` and include structured product data (name, price in UGX, images, specifications, reviews).
- Checkout, account, and dashboard routes (`/checkout`, `/profile`, `/dashboard`, `/wishlist`, `/auth`) are private/transactional and excluded from indexing — see `/robots.txt`.
- A machine-readable sitemap is available at `https://dennan.ug/sitemap.xml`.
